objectives.atomic_adaptation: 0.5 mean P BCE + 0.5 mean same 100 isolated fact BCE + penalty

Evaluate the factual truth of the statement below. AND requires both parts to be true. OR requires at least one part to be true, including both. Output exactly True or False.
{statement}
behavior.template: native model chat user message only, generation prefix, no extra system message
behavior.likelihood: full exact continuation sequence; no added whitespace, length normalization or end-of-turn; verify prompt boundary and save candidate token IDs

generation.acceptance: trim outer whitespace/remove only termination tokens; exact case True or False; all else format failure and incorrect

behavior.isolated_mask: all four isolated likelihood decisions correct per pair/model/prompt; all16 compounds retained; no compound correctness filtering
behavior.primary: all50 pairs; mask is secondary and population-specific
behavior.denominators: disagreement valid canonical generation only; format failure all outputs
